# Pathfinder coding-agent instructions

Use [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical compact guide. Route by task, load current topic docs selectively, and do not preload [`../DEVELOPER_REFERENCE.md`](../DEVELOPER_REFERENCE.md).

Before adding tooling, check [`../docs/tooling-catalog.md`](../docs/tooling-catalog.md), `package.json`, `scripts/`, and workflows. Solver optimization follows the live queue and level-blindness contract. Validate with [`../docs/testing.md`](../docs/testing.md) and never claim an unrun check passed.
